description.narrative: The project consists of the subscription by IDB Invest and certain accredited investors to a thematic sustainability-linked bond to be issued by Mobiliare Latam S.A. (the “Company”) through an international private placement not registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and subject to the applicable exemptions from registration requirements. The proceeds will be used to finance the development, acquisition, and expansion of industrial and logistics real estate assets in Latin America. The structure will allow the Company to access medium- and long-term financing conditions to implement projects under environmental and social standards.The main objective is to support the expansion of the regional portfolio under sustainability and operational efficiency criteria, promoting job creation and strengthening industrial infrastructure in the region. IDB Invest will participate as the lead financier of the project.
